title: Summary: Errors
objective: Write a function that tries to find a file, returns Found or Missing, and print the result.
hint: Define Test-File with a param block taking [string]$Path. Inside, try Get-Item -Path $Path -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null, then return Found. In catch, return Missing. Store the call in $result, then print missing.txt: and $result, then Checks run: 1.
